rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a fee paid to use a road or bridge.

example.english: The toll for this new bridge is really quite expensive.
example.traditional: 呢條新橋嘅過路費真係幾貴。
example.jyutping: nei1 tiu4 san1 kiu4 ge3 gwo3 lou6 fai3 zan1 hai6 gei2 gwai3

rows.note: Use this specifically for a fee paid for the right to sell goods from a stall at a fair or market.

example.english: The toll for a stall at this Lunar New Year market has gone up a lot.
example.traditional: 今次年宵花市嘅攤位費加咗好多。
example.jyutping: gam1 ci3 nin4 siu1 faa1 si5 ge3 taan1 wai2 fai3 gaa1 zo2 hou2 do1

rows.note: Use this for loss or damage caused by a disaster or conflict; it is the all-purpose choice for this consequence sense.

example.english: The toll of this flood was greater than expected.
example.traditional: 今次水災造成嘅損失，比預期仲要大。
example.jyutping: gam1 ci3 seoi2 zoi1 zou6 sing4 ge3 syun2 sat1 bei2 jyu6 kei4 zung6 jiu3 daai6
